articles.title: 'Threat On Canada's Border?’: Kash Patel Asked Point-Blank; FBI Takes Brunt Of Trump’s Tariff War
articles.description: FBI Director Kash Patel has addressed security concerns along America’s northern border with Canada, saying encounters involving known or suspected terrorists have fallen while U.S. law enforcement maintains an increased presence at the border.During a Senate oversight hearing, Patel said the number of known or suspected terrorists encountered at both the northern and southern borders had dropped. He credited stronger southern-border security and “the presence of law enforcement and DHS on the northern border.”

articles.title: INDIA bloc’s ECI march today: Security stepped up as Opposition targets CEC Gyanesh Kumar
articles.description: Security measures have been increased outside the Election Commission of India ahead of a planned protest by opposition MPs. The MPs will march to raise concerns regarding alleged irregularities in the electoral process and to demand transparency. Various leaders from the INDIA alliance, including Biju Janata Dal members, will participate in the protest. Congress representatives have emphasized peaceful demonstrations and ongoing district-level activities until October 8.

articles.title: Pahalgam handler rallies LeT support via anti-Israel rhetoric
articles.description: Saifullah Kasuri made controversial remarks regarding the Pakistan army's role in regional conflicts. He threatened to erase Israel from the world map and defend Saudi holy sites. After the Pahalgam attack, he has been active in public events to raise support. High-level meetings between Lashkar-e-Taiba and Hamas have been reported, indicating growing connections. Kasuri's actions reflect an increasing boldness post-attack, as he recruits youth and gathers funds.

articles.description: As a Saudi-led coalition launched fresh strikes on Houthi positions in Yemen’s Hodeidah governorate, the Iran-aligned group claimed attacks on targets inside Saudi Arabia, including Riyadh and Aramco facilities.

articles.title: Legislative privilege vs free speech: Supreme Court 7-judge bench may close case
articles.description: Nearly 23 years after the Tamil Nadu assembly's breach of privilege resolution, a Supreme Court hearing is scheduled. The resolution imposed a 15-day sentence on some journalists but has since been withdrawn. Senior advocates claimed that the writ petition's cause of action no longer exists and argued the matter has become academic. As a result, the Supreme Court is expected to dispose of the petitions.

articles.description: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth spoke to students in Colorado Springs amid calls for his resignation. This comes as Republican Rep. Thomas Massie has introduced eight articles of impeachment against Hegseth, accusing the Pentagon chief of continuing military operations against Iran without congressional authorization and violating the War Powers Resolution. The allegations have not been adjudicated, and the Pentagon has defended Hegseth’s leadership.

articles.description: The United States has removed all of its B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford in the UK, the Pentagon confirmed on Sunday, a week after five men were arrested over a suspected terror plot at the base.

articles.title: Democracy in peril as voters illegally ousted: Ex-SC judge Nariman
articles.description: Justice Rohinton Fali Nariman expressed concerns regarding the functioning of the Election Commission in India. He highlighted the issue of illegal removal of voters from electoral lists, especially in West Bengal. Nariman noted that 90 lakh voters were disenfranchised, with many not having access to justice. He emphasized the need for reform in the appointment process of election commissioners to ensure fairness.

articles.title: ‘Canada Calls Trump’s Bluff?’: U.S. Bows Down After Mark Carney’s NATO Threat; Tariff ‘Deal Soon’
articles.description: President Donald Trump has reopened the door to a trade deal with Canada even as tensions between Washington and Ottawa remain at their highest level in years.Asked whether an agreement with Canada was still possible, Trump said a deal would eventually be reached, despite accusing Canada of treating the United States “very unfairly” and calling it one of the most difficult countries to deal with. He predicted that Ottawa would return to Washington within weeks seeking an agreement.

articles.title: Jignesh Mevani demands FIR against BJP leader for remarks on sister
articles.description: Congress MLA Jignesh Mevani held a sit-in protest in Gandhinagar demanding the arrest of a BJP leader for posting obscene remarks against his sister. He questioned the police's inaction, comparing it to the swift action taken in a similar case.

articles.title: ‘China-Russia-Korea Axis…’: Trump’s Golden Dome Gets Nuclear Threat; Xi Stabs U.S. After Visit
articles.description: President Donald Trump’s Golden Dome missile-defense project is facing a stark warning over the expanding nuclear and missile capabilities of China, Russia and North Korea, as lawmakers examine whether existing U.S. defenses can keep pace with a rapidly changing threat environment.At a Senate Armed Services Strategic Forces hearing chaired by Sen. Deb Fischer, experts warned that Russia and China have spent years developing increasingly sophisticated nuclear and conventional weapons. Testimony highlighted Russia’s Sarmat and Oreshnik systems, nuclear-capable torpedoes and China’s expanding ICBM infrastructure, hypersonic weapons and other advanced capabilities.

articles.title: Iran says no military solution to war as peace talks with US stall
articles.description: Iran's diplomat said on Sunday there was no military solution to the US war against Iran as peace talks appeared stalled. Washington has scaled back attacks in favour of economic pressure, while Iran's attempted Hormuz blockade remains contentious. A UK maritime agency reported another tanker hit by an unidentified projectile.

articles.title: Iran will not hesitate to deliver a stronger blow than before? Araghchi’s dark message for Trump
articles.description: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi has said Tehran remains committed to both diplomacy and defending itself, warning that any renewed military confrontation would draw a stronger response. Speaking in Tehran on October 4, Araghchi said Iran remains ready to pursue what he called a “just and honourable solution” through diplomacy to end the war. He also highlighted recent meetings with neighbouring countries, particularly Gulf states, describing them as productive and friendly. Araghchi said Iran and its neighbours have begun a new trust-building process aimed at establishing peace, stability and security in the Persian Gulf through regional cooperation.

articles.title: Iran’s revenge strike is locked and loaded? Europe’s biggest American bases are in the crosshairs
articles.description: Fresh intelligence warnings have raised concerns over potential Iranian-linked attacks on U.S. military bases in Europe. According to reports, Israel warned Germany about possible threats to the Spangdahlem and Ramstein air bases, while RAF Fairford in Britain was also identified as a potential target. U.S. intelligence agencies and Western allies reportedly shared warnings with American military leaders in September. Classified assessments suggested drones could be used in any subsequent attacks. The warnings come amid heightened tensions involving Iran, Israel, Russia and the U.S. Iran’s Revolutionary Guards had previously warned over the use of British bases for strikes against Iranian territory.

articles.title: Merz arrives in Kyiv with aid; back home, his party hits a new low as Germans back pro-Russia AfD
articles.description: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz arrived in Kyiv with fresh military and energy support for Ukraine as a new INSA poll showed his CDU/CSU alliance falling to a record-low 18 percent, while the AfD climbed to 30 percent. Merz was expected to announce €1 billion in military aid and advance a joint drone-production agreement during the visit. The trip came after major CDU setbacks in eastern Germany, where the AfD recorded strong results in Saxony-Anhalt and Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania. Merz continued to defend support for Ukraine and higher defence spending, while warning of alleged Russian hybrid attacks across Europe. Moscow dismissed Berlin’s claims as “nonsense.”

articles.title: 'Going to hunt you down…': Mullin shows deportation flights in action | US immigration crackdown
articles.description: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin shared footage of deportation planes being loaded in Louisiana, saying the Trump administration will continue removing people who entered the U.S. illegally. The departures come as the administration expands deportation flights amid the migrant crackdown.

articles.title: Kim oversees 1,000-km hypersonic missile test as Pyongyang claims Seoul, Tokyo failed to track it
articles.description: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un oversaw a reported intermediate-range missile test as Pyongyang showcased what it described as a hypersonic strategic weapons system. North Korea’s KCNA said the missile was launched on October 3 and struck a target about 1,000 kilometres away in the sea, while South Korea said it detected a ballistic missile that flew more than 700 kilometres toward the East Sea. Kim Yo Jong claimed South Korea and Japan failed to fully track the missile, citing what Pyongyang described as a “wave-like trajectory mode.” The test came amid heightened tensions on the Korean Peninsula, while U.S. President Donald Trump highlighted his ties with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.
